provenance.canonical-source: tokens/versions/v0_192/_md-comp-elevated-card.scss AND _md-comp-filled-card.scss AND _md-comp-outlined-card.scss — all THREE, because as with input's filled/outlined text field, select's filled/outlined select and tabs' primary/secondary navigation tab, these are not three components but one component with a mechanism axis (prop.variant). tokens/versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-{elevated,filled,outlined}-card.scss read for the edition diff. tokens/_md-comp-{elevated,filled,outlined}-card.scss (material-web's own hand-authored wrappers) read for what the shipped library actually supports. Resolution through versions/v0_192/{_md-sys-color.scss (values-light() and values-dark() live in ONE file here — v0.192 has no _md-sys-color__dark.scss),_md-ref-palette.scss,_md-sys-elevation.scss,_md-sys-shape.scss,_md-sys-state.scss} plus the hand-authored, edition-independent tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss (see the focus-indicator provenance entry). versions/latest/sass/_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss is NOT used and DOES NOT EXIST in v0.192.
provenance.edition-pin: versions/v0_192. OWNER DECISION: every M3 column pins the v0.192 edition, because material-web's own wrappers @use versions/v0_192 — and all three of tokens/_md-comp-{elevated,filled,outlined}-card.scss do exactly that. The counter-argument this column used to record is now the decision. A full mechanical key/value diff of all three card files across the two editions finds ZERO value divergences among the shared keys; `latest` adds exactly four keys to each file. Three of those four are the focus-indicator family (focus-indicator-color -> secondary, focus-indicator-outline-offset -> md-sys-state-focus-indicator.$outer-offset = 2px, focus-indicator-thickness -> $thickness = 3px) and the fourth, container-surface-tint-layer-color, arrives @deprecated in all three and was never modelled here. THE FOCUS RING IS NOT LOST, BUT ITS SOURCE MOVED — read this carefully, it is the one substantive consequence of the pin for this column. versions/latest/sass/_md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss does not exist in v0.192 at all, so md.comp.card.focus-indicator.* is unreachable under this pin. What IS reachable, and is edition-INDEPENDENT, is material-web's own hand-authored tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss, which the shipped md-focus-ring element consumes and which resolves through the TOP-LEVEL md-sys-color/md-sys-shape/md-sys-motion shims — every one of which reads @use versions/v0_192/... . Its values are $color: md-sys-color.secondary, $width: 3px, $outward-offset: 2px — IDENTICAL, value for value, to the three card focus-indicator tokens they replace. So the ring renders the same and only its citation changes, from a per-component token family to the standalone focus-ring component's. This is the same source button.m3.json and calendar.m3.json already cite for their rings, so the pin makes three columns agree where they previously disagreed. DECLARED, NOT SILENT: the substituted family is a DIFFERENT token set (md.comp.focus-ring.* rather than md.comp.card.focus-indicator.*), and if the owner wants strict per-component sourcing then style.surface.focus becomes a declared gap and an M3 card loses its only focus affordance entirely. WHAT DOES CHANGE VALUE: the state-layer opacities. versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss gives focus 0.12 and pressed 0.12 where versions/latest/sass gives both 0.1 — see style.state-layer.opacity@focus and @pressed. hover 0.08 and dragged 0.16 are identical in both. docs/foundations/state-layers.md already tabulates the v0.192 numbers, so the foundations page and this column now agree (it was edition-stale before, and is correct now — cited, not edited).
provenance.material-web-disowns-almost-everything: The single most important fact about this column. material-web's three hand-authored card wrappers each list only FOUR tokens under $supported-tokens — container-color, container-elevation, container-shadow-color, container-shape (outlined adds outline-color and outline-width) — and put EVERY interaction token under $unsupported-tokens, above two literal TODOs: `TODO(b/307362112): Add interactive card tokens (hover, focus, pressed)` and `TODO(b/307361748): Add disabled cards tokens.` That disowned set is: all disabled-*, all dragged-*, all hover-*, all focus-*, all pressed-*, icon-color and icon-size. So the generated token file describes an interactive, stateful, icon-bearing card and the shipped library implements a bare surface. This column takes the GENERATED token's values and records the disownment — the same resolution SELECT-MATRIX.md finding 6, DIALOG-MATRIX.md finding 8 and TABS-MATRIX.md finding 11 reached, now for the fourth time.
provenance.surface-bg-*: container-color per variant: elevated -> md-sys-color.$surface-container-low -> neutral96 #f7f2fa light / neutral10 #1d1b20 dark; filled -> $surface-container-highest -> neutral90 #e6e0e9 / neutral22 #36343b; outlined -> $surface -> neutral98 #fef7ff / neutral6 #141218. Three DIFFERENT surface roles, which is the point: the variant axis is a mechanism choice, and each mechanism picks its own tone to go with it.
provenance.surface-elevation / shadow-level1 / shad: container-elevation per variant: elevated -> md-sys-elevation.$level1 (1dp), filled and outlined -> $level0 (0). hover-container-elevation: elevated -> $level2 (3dp), filled and outlined -> $level1. pressed- and focus-container-elevation return to each variant's RESTING level in every case (1/0/0). M3 ships a dp HEIGHT, not a shadow string (docs/foundations/elevation.md), so the two-layer CSS is [R], derived exactly the way select.m3.json derived its level-2 and dialog.m3.json its level-3 rather than invented, and mode-invariant because container-shadow-color -> md-sys-color.$shadow -> neutral0 #000 in both schemes. NOTE FOR THE OWNER: button.m3.json's level-1 hover shadow reads `0 1px 3px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.3)`, which has both layers at 0.3 and the layer order swapped relative to the value used here and to the level-2/level-3 derivations in select/dialog. This column uses the form consistent with those two. Flagged, not edited — it is another component's file.
provenance.outline-color / outline-color-focus: outlined variant only. outline-color -> md-sys-color.$outline-variant -> neutral-variant80 #cac4d0 light / neutral-variant30 #49454f dark, at outline-width 1px. AND A REAL FINDING: hover-outline-color, pressed-outline-color and dragged-outline-color ALL resolve to $outline-variant too, i.e. identical to the resting stroke — the only state that moves an M3 card's outline is FOCUS, whose focus-outline-color is $on-surface (#1d1b20 / #e6e0e9). disabled-outline-color is $outline (neutral-variant50/60) at disabled-outline-opacity 0.12; see the disabled note.
provenance.layer-color: {hover,focus,pressed,dragged}-state-layer-color -> md-sys-color.$on-surface in all three variants — one colour for every state and every variant. Opacities from versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss, the pinned edition: hover 0.08, focus 0.12, pressed 0.12, dragged 0.16. VALUES CHANGED BY THE PIN — this column previously carried latest's focus 0.1 and pressed 0.1. docs/foundations/state-layers.md tabulates exactly this v0.192 set, so the foundations page is now in agreement with the column rather than edition-stale; CARD-MATRIX.md finding 11 (lesson 9) is resolved by the pin rather than by an edit. Dragged is out of scope: no drag behaviour is modelled for any column.
provenance.icon-color / icon-size: icon-color -> md-sys-color.$primary -> primary40 #6750a4 / primary80 #d0bcff; icon-size 24px, hardcoded, identical in both editions and all three variants. This is the ONLY sub-part any M3 card token file describes, and its colour is deliberately NOT a text role — the inverse of TABS-MATRIX.md finding 9, where thirteen M3 icon-colour tokens all duplicated the label colour.
provenance.focus-indicator: SOURCE MOVED BY THE v0.192 PIN, VALUES UNCHANGED. Previously: focus-indicator-color -> md-sys-color.$secondary, focus-indicator-thickness -> md-sys-state-focus-indicator.$thickness = 3px, focus-indicator-outline-offset -> $outer-offset = +2px, all three from versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-{elevated,filled,outlined}-card.scss. None of those tokens exists in versions/v0_192, and neither does the _md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss they resolve through. NOW SOURCED FROM tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss — material-web's hand-authored token set for the standalone md-focus-ring element, which is edition-independent (it @use's the top-level md-sys-color/md-sys-shape/md-sys-motion shims, all of which @use versions/v0_192): $color: md-sys-color.secondary -> secondary40 #625b71 light / secondary80 #ccc2dc dark; $width: 3px; $outward-offset: 2px. Every number and every colour is identical to what the card focus-indicator family gave, so the slot value #625b71 / #ccc2dc did not move. ALSO IN THAT FILE, not modelled here: $inward-offset 0px, $active-width 8px, $shape corner-full, $duration md-sys-motion.duration-long4. NOTE THE OFFSET, retained from the previous entry and still true: the card takes the OUTWARD offset (+2px) where a navigation tab takes the inward one, so an M3 card's ring sits OUTSIDE the surface. Under this pin the tab can no longer express its inward offset at all — see tabs.m3.json.
provenance.shape: container-shape -> md-sys-shape.$corner-medium = 12px, identical in all three variants and both editions. M3 goes the opposite way to shadcn here: its card is corner-MEDIUM while its dialog is corner-extra-large (28px), where shadcn's card (14px) is rounder than its dialog (10px).
provenance.no-layout-tokens: CONFIRMED ABSENCE: none of the three card files contains a padding, gap, width, height, min-height or motion token, in either edition — they are container colour, elevation, shadow colour, shape, one outline pair, one icon pair and the state families. There is also NO header, title, supporting-text, content or action token (contrast _md-comp-dialog.scss, which has headline-* and supporting-text-*, and _md-comp-banners-rich.scss, which has title-text-* and actions-*). The single layout number in this column, the 16px container padding, is therefore [R] — a DECLARED BORROW from m3.material.io's published card spec, flagged on its own cell, the same treatment TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md gave M3's plain-tooltip padding and DIALOG-MATRIX.md its eight basic-dialog numbers. NO TOKEN NAME WAS INVENTED FOR IT.
provenance.tokens-only-clone: material-web is a tokens-only clone — `find . -maxdepth 2 -type d` returns only tokens/ — so there is no card element to grep and every structure and behavior row in this column is [R]. Every STYLE cell is [S].
provenance.disabled-is-two-mechanisms: elevated and filled carry disabled-container-color (surface / surface-variant) plus disabled-container-opacity 0.38; outlined carries NO container-opacity at all and instead disables its STROKE — disabled-outline-color $outline at disabled-outline-opacity 0.12. This column models the 0.38 container opacity and DECLARES the outlined divergence rather than modelling it, because material-web disowns the entire disabled family for all three variants anyway (docs/CARD-MATRIX.md declared approximation 4).

structure.media.note: no image token in any of the three card files in either edition — and the absence is deliberate, because the BANNER does tokenise its media. CITATION RE-POINTED BY THE v0.192 PIN: this note previously cited versions/latest/sass/_md-comp-banners-rich.scss (image.size 80px, image.shape corner-none), a file that does not exist in the pinned edition. The equivalent in versions/v0_192/_md-comp-banner.scss is with-image-image-size 40px and with-image-image-shape -> md-sys-shape.corner-full. The finding is unchanged and if anything sharper — M3 tokenises banner media in BOTH editions and card media in NEITHER — only the dimensions of the banner image moved (80px square -> 40px circle). See alert.m3.json structure.image.

structure.title.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no headline/title token, unlike _md-comp-dialog.scss's headline-* family

structure.action.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no action token, unlike _md-comp-dialog.scss's action-* family

structure.state-layer.source: {hover,focus,pressed,dragged}-state-layer-{color,opacity} in all three variants; listed under $unsupported-tokens by material-web

structure.card-icon.source: icon-size 24px + icon-color primary — the only sub-part any M3 card token file describes; both listed under $unsupported-tokens by material-web

structure.group.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no group or selection container token

structure.sectioning.note: there are no section tokens at all, so an M3 card is one padded box; nothing to detect and nothing to hand padding to

behavior.role.note: [R] — tokens-only clone, no card element to grep. The state-layer family (present in BOTH editions) says an M3 card CAN be a control; APG makes a clickable card a button. NOTE the focus-indicator family, which used to be half of this argument, does not exist in the pinned v0.192 edition

behavior.tab-stop.note: [R] — no element exists. Under the previous latest pin the argument was that a focus-indicator token implies a focusable element; that token family is gone under the v0.192 pin, so the argument now rests on the state-layer family (which includes focus-state-layer-color/-opacity in BOTH editions) plus the fact that material-web ships an md-focus-ring element for exactly this purpose. Weaker evidence, same conclusion, flagged rather than quietly carried.

behavior.keyboard-activation.note: [R] per APG's button pattern; nothing in the clone to grep

behavior.active-flag.note: no JS flag exists in a tokens-only clone. M3's pressed layer is a ripple in the real library; the chassis drives its pressed rows from its own data-active flag so a keyboard activation is visible — DECLARED (docs/CARD-MATRIX.md declared approximation 3)

behavior.disabled-handling.note: disabled TOKENS exist [S] (see the disabled-is-two-mechanisms provenance entry) but material-web disowns them and there is no element, so the DOM handling is [R]

behavior.nested-interactive.note: no element exists to ask. Recorded as unanswerable rather than guessed, because this is the one question where guessing wrong is an accessibility defect rather than a visual one

prop.variant.source: three generated token files, three mechanisms: a level-1 shadow over surface-container-low; a flat fill of surface-container-highest with no shadow; plain surface with a 1px outline-variant stroke and no shadow. NO SOURCE DEFAULT EXISTS — material-web ships three peer elements and neither the token files nor its wrappers name one as primary, so the list is in the spec's own published order and the absence is recorded rather than a default invented, exactly as tabs.m3.json's prop.emphasis did

prop.container-tone.note: M3 has no tone ladder — the container colour is decided by the variant, not by a separate axis

prop.interaction.source: static first: every interaction token is state-qualified (hover-*, focus-*, pressed-*) and the unqualified enabled state is the base reading. `button` is carried because the state-layer and hover-elevation families are real, sourced in BOTH editions, and would otherwise be unreachable in the harness (the focus-indicator family that used to be cited here alongside them is latest-only and unreachable under the v0.192 pin — the ring now comes from tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss instead) — but its ROLE and keyboard contract are [R], and material-web disowns the whole interactive family with an open TODO

prop.disabled.source: disabled-container-opacity 0.38 (elevated, filled) and disabled-outline-color/-opacity 0.12 (outlined), plus disabled-container-color and disabled-container-elevation. A capability list. All of it under $unsupported-tokens

prop.hoverable.note: hover styling is a property of being interactive; there is no decorative opt-in

state.rest.value: one of three mechanisms — level-1 shadow / surface-container-highest fill / 1px outline-variant stroke

state.hover.value: state layer on-surface 8% + an elevation lift (1->2 / 0->1 / 0->1)
state.hover.note: and the outlined variant's STROKE does not move: hover-outline-color is outline-variant, the same as at rest

state.focus.value: 3px solid secondary at outline-offset +2px, plus a 12% state layer
state.focus.note: VALUE CHANGED BY THE v0.192 PIN: the state layer was 10% under latest's md-sys-state, and versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss says focus-state-layer-opacity 0.12. The ring itself is unchanged in value but its source moved from the card own focus-indicator family (latest-only) to the edition-independent tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss — see provenance.focus-indicator. Still the OUTWARD offset, where the navigation tab used the inward one (which the pin removes entirely).

state.pressed.value: elevation returns to the variant's resting level, plus a 12% state layer
state.pressed.note: the same direction as Salt's press, by a different mechanism

state.selected.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no selected token in any card file

state.disabled.value: 38% container opacity (elevated, filled) / a 12%-opacity outline stroke (outlined)
state.disabled.note: two mechanisms; the second is declared, not modelled

style.surface.background.note: variant=elevated (value[0]), read through the indirection the variant rows reassign

style.surface.color.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no text colour token on any card variant, only an icon colour

style.surface.font.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no typescale token in any card file

style.surface.border-width.note: 0 on elevated and filled; the outlined row raises it to outline-width = 1px — the mechanism axis expressed as a width

style.surface.border-color.note: transparent on elevated and filled; the outlined row swaps it for outline-variant

style.surface.shape.source: container-shape -> md-sys-shape.$corner-medium, identical in all three variants and both editions

style.surface.padding.note: [R] DECLARED BORROW from m3.material.io's published card spec — none of the three card token files carries a spacing token in either edition. The single [R] layout number in this column; no token name invented for it

style.surface.gap.note: no sections and no gap token

style.surface.elevation.note: [R] CSS derived from container-elevation (level1 elevated / level0 filled and outlined) + container-shadow-color #000; see the surface-elevation provenance entry

style.surface.transition.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no motion token in any card file, so no transition is claimed even though the elevation demonstrably changes on hover

style.surface.elevation@hover.source: hover-container-elevation: level2 (elevated) / level1 (filled, outlined). No cursor token exists in M3, so unlike Salt this row sets no cursor

style.surface.pressed.source: pressed-container-elevation returns to each variant's RESTING level (1/0/0) from the hovered level (2/1/1) — an M3 card settles back down under the finger

style.surface.focus.source: tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss $width 3px / $color md-sys-color.secondary / $outward-offset 2px — SOURCE RE-POINTED BY THE v0.192 PIN, values identical to the card focus-indicator family it replaces (see provenance.focus-indicator). border-color reproduces focus-outline-color -> on-surface, which is an outlined-variant token; on elevated and filled the border width is 0 so the recolour is invisible, which is the correct outcome rather than an approximation. box-shadow restates focus-container-elevation, which equals the resting level in all three variants — so focus does NOT lift an M3 card, where focus DOES lift a Salt one

style.surface.disabled.source: disabled-container-opacity 0.38 (elevated, filled). Specified by M3 as the CONTAINER's opacity and applied here to the element, since there is no separate container node. The outlined variant's different mechanism is declared, not modelled

style.surface.pointer-events@disabled.note: no such rule; Salt's descendant pointer-events trick is Salt's alone

style.surface.variant@filled.source: _md-comp-filled-card.scss: container-color surface-container-highest, container-elevation level0, hover-container-elevation level1. A FILL replaces the shadow — a different mechanism, not a colour delta

style.surface.variant@outlined.source: _md-comp-outlined-card.scss: container-color surface (no tonal lift), container-elevation level0, outline-width 1px, outline-color outline-variant. A STROKE replaces the shadow — the third mechanism

style.state-layer.rest.source: {hover,focus,pressed}-state-layer-color -> on-surface in all three variants — one colour, so the interaction rows only move the opacity

style.state-layer.opacity@hover.source: versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss hover-state-layer-opacity: 0.08 — identical in both editions, so the pin does not move it (unlike focus and pressed beside it)

style.state-layer.opacity@focus.source: versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss focus-state-layer-opacity: 0.12. VALUE CHANGED BY THE PIN — was 0.1, from versions/latest/sass/_md-sys-state.scss $focus-state-layer-opacity. docs/foundations/state-layers.md already tabulates 0.12 for M3, so the foundations page and this cell now agree.

style.state-layer.opacity@pressed.source: versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss pressed-state-layer-opacity: 0.12. VALUE CHANGED BY THE PIN — was 0.1, from versions/latest/sass/_md-sys-state.scss $pressed-state-layer-opacity. docs/foundations/state-layers.md already tabulates 0.12 for M3.

style.card-icon.size.source: icon-size 24px, density-invariant (M3 has no density capability — docs/foundations/density.md)

style.card-icon.color.source: icon-color -> md-sys-color.$primary — deliberately NOT a text role, so a currentColor glyph would be wrong here
